1 SCOPE
This standard covers description of terms related to disease of head and nervous system. The original terms appearing in the text (as per Unani classical literature) have been transliterated in Hindi and English. Possible English equivalents and description has been given for the purpose of clear understanding of Unani terms by any person. These terms may be used by researchers, manufacturers, academicians, regulators, clinical practitioners etc.
